subject: Recap + PoC recommendation: Deployment mode options & proposed trial plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex.li@startercorp.com>, Priya Singh <priya@startercorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + PoC recommendation: Deployment mode options & proposed trial plan

Hi Alex / Priya

Thanks again for the time today good conversation and helpful context on StarterCorp's latency and compliance needs. Quick recap and our recommended next steps so we have alignment before I put the PoC SOW together.

What we heard (summary)
- Workload: high-throughput batch scoring for user personalization + interactive chat for internal ops.
- Performance targets: p50 latency target ~ <200ms for interactive flows, sustained batch throughput ~800 reqs/s for nightly scoring.
- Data & compliance: some datasets contain regulated PII and must remain in customer-controlled network; SOC2 and E2E encryption required.
- Timeline: want a 2–4 week trial to validate integration and perf; procurement/legal want an initial pilot SOW.

Deployment mode recommendation (short list)
1) Hosted API (quick win) fastest path to validate integration and business logic. Good for early functional tests and embedding calls. Not recommended for regulated PII.
2) Dedicated capacity (recommended for perf) reserved GPU pool to meet sustained throughput and predictable latency; allows us to tune batching/quant profiles for your load.
3) Private VPC / on-prem (compliance) recommended where StarterCorp policy requires customer-controlled networking/KMS. This is the heavier lift and typically follows proof of performance on Dedicated.

Proposed PoC / trial plan (two-track, pragmatic)
- Track A (Week 1–2): Hosted API quick validation
  - Purpose: Verify integration, schema/contract, and initial functional correctness (chat endpoints, tokenization).
  - Success criteria: integration complete; sample requests succeed; basic latency measured; demo to ops.
- Track B (Week 2–4): Dedicated capacity performance PoC
  - Purpose: Validate sustained throughput and latency under realistic load.
  - Success criteria: p50 interactive <200ms; batch throughput >=800 reqs/s with <5% error rate; cost estimate within target range.
- Parallel activity: Security/compliance readiness for Private VPC (legal/procurement kickoff)
  - Deliverable: StarterCorp security questionnaire + high-level network/KMS checklist (we'll provide evidence items).

Stakeholders we need from StarterCorp
- Technical lead (integration) owns API integration and test harness
- Infra/Cloud contact access to load-testing endpoints and any network config
- Security/Compliance contact to review SOC2 evidence and discuss VPC requirements
- Procurement/Legal to review pilot SOW and standard terms

Next steps (please confirm)
1) Can you confirm stakeholders and the procurement contact so we can route the SOW?
2) I'll attach a draft PoC SOW + PoC playbook; if that looks good we'll send a DocuSign for signature and schedule kickoff.
3) If you prefer, Redwood can stand up a Dedicated trial environment for the perf PoC once SOW is signed.

Attachments: Redwood_PoC_Playbook_v1.xlsx, StarterCorp_PoC_SOW_v1.pdf

Thanks I'll wait for your stakeholder confirmation and any additional security artifacts (you mentioned a questionnaire).

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0192

Redwood Inference | Developer-first LLM inference

Thanks Marissa helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side:

- We will need Private VPC for any pipeline that touches regulated PII; however, our app design team is open to doing an initial Hosted API integration for non-PII flows so we can move faster.
- Procurement: procurement@startercorp.com (please copy) they'll need the SOW and any standard SLAs.
- Security: attaching our completed SOC2 security questionnaire. Can you confirm how fast Redwood can provide the evidence items listed (logs retention, KMS support)?
- Dedicated trial: yes please we'd like Redwood to provision a dedicated trial environment for the perf test. What minimum commit or credit do you need?

Alex great, thanks for the quick reply and for sending the questionnaire. Next steps from Redwood's side and proposed timeline below.

Two-track PoC (finalized plan)
- Week 0 (next 3 business days): Procurement/legal review I'll send the SOW to procurement@startercorp.com via DocuSign.
- Week 1: Hosted API integration (non-PII flows) engineering integration support from Redwood (1x Solutions Engineer) to validate endpoints and run basic smoke tests.
- Week 2-3: Dedicated capacity performance PoC Redwood will provision a dedicated trial environment (no long-term commit for trial). Our infra team will provide a temporary credit-based environment for 2 weeks to validate perf.
- Week 3-4 (parallel): Private VPC readiness begin legal/network discussions; we'll compile evidence bundle (SOC2 excerpts, retention policy, KMS integration notes).

Milestones / success criteria (restated)
- Hosted: integration complete + demo to your ops team.
- Dedicated: p50 interactive <200ms, batch >=800 reqs/s, error rate <5%.
- Compliance: necessary evidence provided and VPC design reviewed by StarterCorp security.

Action items I will take this week
- Send SOW via DocuSign to procurement@startercorp.com (target: EOD Thu) doc link: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123-def
- Provision dedicated trial environment once SOW is signed (no long-term commit required for trial; we'll document performance baseline).
- Share Redwood evidence pack for the questionnaire items (expected by Fri).

Requests for your team
- Please confirm the technical lead for the Hosted integration and the infra contact for load testing windows.
- Procurement: confirm any required PO or vendor form specifics so the SOW can be updated if needed.

I'll put the PoC SOW and the playbook in the Drive folder and follow up with a calendar invite for kickoff once the SOW is out.

Thanks looking forward to running this with you.
